header: An image with a numbered legend
lead: Each entry names a numbered spot in the image and explains it in one sentence. The numbers follow the order of the entries.
caption: The image takes the wider of the two columns.

callouts.title: Markers are part of the image
callouts.text: Markers placed over a responsive image would only be correct at one screen width.

callouts.title: The legend is an ordered list
callouts.text: Screen reader users get the sequence without seeing the numbered circles.

callouts.title: Reverse swaps the columns
callouts.text: The order in the HTML stays the same. Only the layout changes sides.

callouts.title: The image gets the wider column
callouts.text: The ratio is three to two, so the numbers in the image stay readable.

image.alternative: A small fenced electrical substation in front of green hills.
